semantics.property_rule: Each tested property/invariant references exact canonical rule or explicit test property identity.

semantics.failure_rule: A reproducible counterexample retains seed/input/profile evidence.
semantics.semantic_rule: Property test does not invent new canonical invariant merely by test code.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

references.purpose: Property failures preserve reproducible generator/seed evidence.
